newsitem.title: FRANCE: Nine reported killed in attack on Algerian bus.
newsitem.headline: Nine reported killed in attack on Algerian bus.

text.p: Nine people were killed when suspected Islamist militants attacked a passenger bus at Kasr El Hirane in Laghouat Province in northern Algeria, Algerian radio reported on Tuesday.
The radio, in a report monitored by the British Broadcasting Corporation, quoted a security forces statement issued on Monday evening as saying a major search for the attackers was under way.
About 50,000 people have died since early 1992 in Algeria's between Islamic militants and the military-backed government.
